analyzed_vuln.description: WriteMIFFImage iterates image properties with ResetImagePropertyIterator/GetNextImageProperty, but during that same iteration it calls GetImageProperty(property), which for synthetic keys like ICC metadata triggers GetICCProperty -> SetImageProperty. SetImageProperty updates the same image->properties splay tree and AddValueToSplayTree frees/replaces an existing key/value when key matches. This mutates and frees nodes/strings while the iterator still holds pointers into the tree, causing stale key pointers and a heap-use-after-free later in splay-tree comparison (LocaleCompare via CompareSplayTreeString).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires encoding to MIFF with an image that has profiles/properties such that querying a property during header write causes lazy property materialization (notably ICC-derived properties). In encoder_miff_fuzzer, crafted input is read into an image containing ICC profile data; during WriteMIFFImage, SetImageProperty("quantum:format",...) and especially GetImageProperty on iterated keys cause in-loop property tree mutation. The iterator then continues over freed key memory, leading to UAF read in LocaleCompare.
